QuestInfo.name: Hatred for the Knights
QuestInfo.0: You learned about the rampant distrust of the Cygnus Knights. Ask #b10 Boogies#k about this.
QuestInfo.1: Ask #b10 Boogies#k why Edelstein citizens dislike the Cygnus Knights.
QuestInfo.2: You asked #b10 Boogies#k why Edelstein citizens dislike the Cygnus Knights. The citizens think that the knights are traitors...
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 150
Can proceed to The 10 Boogies Challenge

0.0: Whatever you do, don't underestimate the citizens of Edelstein. I didn't tell them who I was, but they figured out I was a Cygnus Knight within three days. Even the kids figured it out!
0.1: You're probably wondering why everyone here hates us so much. You want to hear the story?

yes.0: It's a long story. Talk to me when you're ready to hear it.

no.0: If you don't understand the tension between our two groups, you'll never be able to pull off your missions.

1.0: So, here's why the citizens of #bEdelstein#k hate the Cygnus Knights...

yes.0: So... Um... The Black Wings took control of #bEdelstein#k to strip it of its natural resources so that they can revive the #rBlack Mage#k, right?
yes.1: Well, some people in #bEdelstein#k didn't like that, so they formed the #bResistance#k. The Empress and her knights grouped up with them, since we have a common enemy and all.
yes.2: The Resistance came up with this amazing plan to defeat the #bBlack Wings#k once and for all, but they needed our help. We promised to send #bCygnus Knights#k to their aid on the day of the battle.
yes.3: But, when the day came, #rsomething unexpected#k happened to us. We could barely defend ourselves, let alone help #bEdelstein#k! \r\nI... I can't talk about what happened to us. It still gives me nightmares. *shudder*
yes.4: In the end, we managed to protect Ereve and the Empress, but at a heavy, heavy cost. And because of our absence, the Black Wings crushed Edelstein.
yes.5: Do you get it now? Everyone here, even the kids, see the #bCygnus Knights#k as traitors.
yes.6: They refuse to have anything to do with us, so you're not likely to get much help from them.
